Package com.egradx.core

Class EgradxApplicationCoreAutoConfigure

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.core.EgradxApplicationCoreAutoConfigure
@AutoConfiguration @ComponentScan(basePackages={"com.egradx.core.control","com.egradx.core.properties"}) public class EgradxApplicationCoreAutoConfigure extends Object
Registers egradx-core's beans: ControlManager, which starts and stops every Control, and EgradxApplicationProperties (egradx.app.*). It used to scan com.egradx.app.core, a package that does not exist, so neither was ever a bean.
